description: Refresh Ceraph camera fixtures after images or videos were added, removed, or changed manually under `.ceraph/`. The filename stem is the key used by `<CeraphCamera mediaKey>`. The camera fixture tools refresh their own writes, so call this only after manual file changes or a git update. Returns the available image and video keys.

projectDir.description: React Native/Expo project directory. Omit when the coding client's workspace identifies one app; supply it to disambiguate projects.

name: rn_sync_camera_registry
